title: Dinoscript · Learn to code with Pip
excerpt: Dinoscript is a free coding editor for kids. Write your first program with Pip the triceratops in your browser or in the offline desktop app.
content_html:
A coding editor for kids

Learn to code
with Pip.

Write your first program, make text games, and solve math puzzles with Pip the triceratops. Dinoscript is free and open source.

Follow the illustrated lessons from your first line of code to loops, functions, and playable games. Read along online, print the PDF, or press F1 in the app to open the lessons offline.

Your first program 

print("Hello, dinosaur!")

Press F5 in Dinoscript to see Hello, dinosaur!
